english.toefl: 90 for June 1, 2025–January 20, 2026 tests; 5 overall with 4.5 Speaking/Writing for tests from January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS Academic/Online: tests from January 21, 2026 also require 6.5 Speaking and Writing. Tests before June 1, 2025 are invalid for Fall 2027. No Duolingo, TOEFL ITP/MyBest, IELTS Indicator or One Test Retake. Exemptions cover qualifying English-country basic degrees, accredited US degrees, or a completed full-time US academic year with B grades; English-medium foreign study alone is insufficient.

documents: Statement of purpose (two to three pages)
Personal history statement (one to two pages)

applicationFee.note: Program reduced fee: $78 international, $68 US/PR, before central payment processing charges. Limited full waivers explicitly include international applicants with significant financial need: nearly complete the application, submit the separate linked request form by November 19, 2026, before submitting/paying. No retroactive waiver.

requirements.note: Bachelor’s or equivalent, GPA 3.0 and sufficient relevant preparation. Laboratory experience recommended. Do not upload papers/publications. All materials including letters due by the deadline.

funding.note: Stipend, registration fees, nonresident tuition and health care for five and a half to six years with satisfactory progress. Admitted international students receive the same support. First year program-funded, later mentor-funded; teaching forms part of support.

international.note: Program reports admitting only two to three international students annually because of cost.
